triggerdefs.def: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_audit_product_changes AFTER UPDATE ON public.products FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.name IS DISTINCT FROM new.name) OR (old.price IS DISTINCT FROM new.price) OR (old.cost_price IS DISTINCT FROM new.cost_price) OR (old.sku IS DISTINCT FROM new.sku) OR (old.price_currency IS DISTINCT FROM new.price_currency))) EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_product_changes()
triggerdefs.name: trigger_audit_product_changes
